meal.title: Access a tag via attribute with dot notation
meal.objective: Retrieve the first occurrence of a tag using dot notation

voice.script: Want the page title in one line? How do you grab the first title tag without searching? You can just treat a tag like an attribute. Instead of looping or calling find, use dot notation. For example, after creating soup, write title_tag = soup.title and then print(title_tag). That accesses the first title element directly. Running this prints something like <title>My Page</title>. Remember, dot access gives you the first occurrence of that tag. Now try accessing the first h1 tag the same way.
